South Meadows Pitt Meadows: streets and boundaries

items.t: South Meadows is the board's name; the City calls this pocket South Bonson, the Bonson Road corridor south of Hammond Road and the Canadian Pacific Kansas City rail tracks to the Fraser River.
Osprey Village, at Fraser Way and Barnston View Road, is the pocket's village centre, and the Golden Ears Business Park lands sit toward Harris Road on its west side.

blocks.text: South Meadows Pitt Meadows: the housing stock

items.t: The guide-level shape is a village pocket: houses on the Bonson Road streets, with townhome and duplex streets around Osprey Village and along Fraser Way.

blocks.text: South Meadows Pitt Meadows: rules that affect buyers

items.t: 2864, 2020, adopted September 27, 2022, which repealed the former Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 2352, 2007 — older plan references for South Bonson are superseded.

blocks.text: South Meadows Pitt Meadows: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Shoreline Park, 51 Bonson Road, sits on the Fraser River dike, and the dyke-top trails run along the river through the pocket.
Bonson Park, 11546 Bonson Road, holds a disc golf course, and Pitt Meadows Athletic Park, 11431 Bonson Road, holds soccer fields and ball diamonds, with the community garden at 11410 Bonson Road.
The Pitt Meadows Arena complex, with three sheets of ice, is in this pocket, while the Pitt Meadows Family Recreation Centre, 12027 Harris Road, is north of it.

blocks.text: South Meadows Pitt Meadows: development and new projects

items.t: Golden Ears Business Park, south Bonson / south Harris Road area, Onni Group, industrial business park: the City records the park being built out in phases on the pocket's west side — status: build-out in phases (as of November 3, 2026).

Pitt Meadows Road and Rail Improvements Project, Harris Road at the Canadian Pacific Kansas City rail crossing, north-west of the pocket: the project includes a new four-lane underpass below the main rail crossing at Harris Road — status: project in delivery (as of November 3, 2026).

Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit, via the Golden Ears Bridge and Lougheed Highway north of this pocket, TransLink: the planned line connects to the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus at the city's north side — status: planned service (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: South Meadows Pitt Meadows: costs and taxes

items.t: One city figure is carried here because it is specific to this dike-protected pocket: the 2026 Annual Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3047, 2026 sets the residential drainage levy at $0.1082 per $1,000 of taxable value, alongside the general municipal rate of $2.8438 per $1,000; full Pitt Meadows tax and utility facts belong to the city pages.

blocks.text: South Meadows Pitt Meadows: getting around

items.t: Routes 719 and 722 run as a combined circular service through Bonson Road and Fraser Way: 719 runs Meadowtown to Fraser Way via Maple Meadows Station, Hammond Road and Bonson Road, continuing as 722, which returns via Harris Road and Hammond Road.

Route 701 runs along Hammond Road at the pocket's north edge to Coquitlam Central Station and Haney Place via Pitt Meadows Station, and the West Coast Express runs weekday trains from Pitt Meadows Station, north of the pocket.

items.t: Check Agricultural Land Reserve status per parcel at the pocket's edges: the City states 78% of Pitt Meadows is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, even though the built South Bonson pocket itself is developed village land.

faq.a: No public school building sits inside this pocket. The closest elementary schools are Edith McDermott Elementary, 12178 Bonson Road, and Pitt Meadows Elementary, 11941 Harris Road, both north of the rail tracks, and Pitt Meadows Secondary, 19438 116B Avenue, is the city's only public secondary school. Catchment is by address in School District No. 42, which has no middle tier.
faq.q: Is there a school inside South Meadows?

faq.a: That result is for that address only; other Bonson Road addresses can return a different elementary school, so run each address.
faq.q: Which catchment did a South Bonson address return?

faq.a: Osprey Village is the commercial and community node at Fraser Way and Barnston View Road, holding the South Bonson Community Centre and the Pitt Meadows Art Gallery at 10932 Barnston View Road, plus the village shops the City's commercial lands analysis names, including Osprey Village Market. It is the services centre for the houses south of the rail tracks.

Yes — the City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of Pitt Meadows lies within the Fraser River and Pitt River floodplain, protected by about 60 kilometres of dikes. This pocket sits behind the Fraser River dike in drainage Area 3 of the local diking district, and the dike itself carries Shoreline Park and the dyke-top trails, so flood and dike checks belong in every purchase here.
